card.name: Christian ministry bylines and credits
card.fires_on: Small linking words and punctuation in Christian ministry text, such as Answers in Genesis credits, pastor or founder bylines, and seminary or church affiliations. It fires on the word right before the organization or church name.

modes.label: Role then organization
modes.description: A linking word after a title like founder, pastor or lecturer, just before a church or ministry name.
modes.example: – Ken Ham, president and founder<< of>> AiG–U.S. Answers magazine

modes.label: Copyright line
modes.description: The year or copyright sign before a creationist ministry name in a magazine footer.
modes.example: Building a Biblical Worldview ISSN: 1937-9056 | © 201<<3>> Answers in Genesis

modes.label: Church-related lists
modes.description: A conjunction or comma in a list of churches, schools or ministries.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward Bible and scripture words as the next word.
card.plain: It spots Christian ministry credits where a word like Bible or Scripture may come next.
